cases.sentence: Одна была ___ «Король Лир в степи», другая был квартет, посвященный памяти Баха.
cases.translation: One was a fantasia, 'King Lear in the Steppe,' the other a quartet dedicated to the memory of Bach.
cases.explain: Фантазия is the predicate noun renaming the subject after была (was), so it stays nominative.

cases.sentence: Одна была фантазия «Король Лир в степи», другая был квартет, посвященный памяти ___.
cases.translation: One was a fantasia 'King Lear in the Steppe', the other a quartet dedicated to the memory of Bach.
cases.explain: The noun памяти (in memory of) requires its complement in the genitive case, hence Баха.

cases.sentence: Проводив свояченицу к ее ___, он стал у колонны и решился как можно внимательнее и добросовестнее слушать.
cases.translation: Having escorted his sister-in-law to her armchair, he stood by a column and resolved to listen as attentively and conscientiously as possible.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) governs the dative case, hence креслу.

cases.sentence: Проводив ___ к ее креслу, он стал у колонны и решился как можно внимательнее и добросовестнее слушать.
cases.translation: Having escorted his sister-in-law to her armchair, he stood by a column and resolved to listen as attentively and conscientiously as possible.
cases.explain: Свояченицу is the direct object of the verb проводив (having escorted), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: ...и рад был, увидав одного из известных знатоков в разговоре со знакомым ему ___.
cases.translation: ...and he was glad to see one of the well-known connoisseurs in conversation with his acquaintance Pestsov.
cases.explain: The preposition со (with) governs the instrumental case, hence Песцовым.

cases.sentence: Тут только Левин вспомнил заглавие фантазии и поспешил прочесть в русском переводе стихи Шекспира, напечатанные на ___ афиши.
cases.translation: Only then did Levin remember the title of the fantasia and hastened to read, in Russian translation, Shakespeare's verses printed on the back of the playbill.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) governs the prepositional case here, hence обороте.

reading.ru: Одна была фантазия «Король Лир в степи», другая был квартет, посвященный памяти Баха.
reading.question: What two pieces were performed at the morning concert?
options: A fantasia on King Lear and a quartet dedicated to Bach's memory
A symphony and an opera aria
A ballet and a choral work
reading.correct: A fantasia on King Lear and a quartet dedicated to Bach's memory
reading.explain: The two new-style pieces were the fantasia 'King Lear in the Steppe' and a quartet dedicated to the memory of Bach.

reading.ru: Проводив свояченицу к ее креслу, он стал у колонны и решился как можно внимательнее и добросовестнее слушать.
reading.question: What did Levin do after seeing his sister-in-law to her seat?
options: He stood by a column and resolved to listen as carefully as possible
reading.correct: He stood by a column and resolved to listen as carefully as possible
reading.explain: After escorting his sister-in-law to her seat, Levin stood by a column, determined to listen as attentively and conscientiously as he could.

reading.ru: Он старался избегать встреч со знатоками музыки и говорунами, а стоял, глядя вниз перед собой, и слушал.
reading.question: Whom did Levin try to avoid at the concert?
reading.explain: Levin tried to avoid meeting music connoisseurs and talkers, standing and listening while looking down instead.

reading.ru: Но чем более он слушал фантазию короля Лира, тем далее он чувствовал себя от возможности составить себе какое-нибудь определенное мнение.
reading.question: What happened to Levin's ability to form an opinion the more he listened?
options: He felt further from forming any definite opinion
He became more certain he loved the piece
reading.correct: He felt further from forming any definite opinion
reading.explain: The more he listened to the King Lear fantasia, the further he felt from being able to form any definite opinion of it.

reading.ru: Левин во время исполнения испытывал чувство глухого, смотрящего на танцующих.
reading.question: What comparison describes Levin's experience during the performance?
options: Like a deaf man watching people dance
Like a blind man listening to a storm
Like a child hearing a lullaby
Like a soldier hearing a battle cry
reading.correct: Like a deaf man watching people dance
reading.explain: During the performance Levin felt like a deaf man watching people dance.

reading.ru: Желая разъяснить по впечатлению других свое недоумение, Левин пошел ходить, отыскивая знатоков, и рад был, увидав одного из известных знатоков в разговоре со знакомым ему Песцовым.
reading.question: Why did Levin go looking for connoisseurs after the piece ended?
options: To clarify his confusion using others' impressions
reading.correct: To clarify his confusion using others' impressions
reading.explain: Wanting to clear up his confusion by learning others' impressions, Levin went looking for connoisseurs and found Pestsov talking with one.

reading.ru: «То есть почему же тут корделия?» — робко спросил Левин, совершенно забыв, что фантазия изображала короля Лира в степи.
reading.question: What mistake did Levin make while talking with Pestsov?
options: He forgot the fantasia depicted King Lear and asked why Cordelia was mentioned
He called Pestsov by the wrong name
reading.correct: He forgot the fantasia depicted King Lear and asked why Cordelia was mentioned
reading.explain: Levin had completely forgotten the fantasia depicted King Lear in the steppe, so he timidly asked why Cordelia came into it.

reading.ru: Левин доказывал, что ошибка Вагнера и всех его последователей в том, что музыка хочет переходить в область чужого искусства, что также ошибается поэзия, когда описывает черты лиц, что должна делать живопись.
reading.question: What argument did Levin make about Wagner's error?
options: That music was overstepping into the domain of other arts
That Wagner's music was too quiet
That Wagner refused to write operas
reading.correct: That music was overstepping into the domain of other arts
reading.explain: Levin argued that Wagner's mistake, like poetry describing faces, was that music wanted to move into the domain of another art.

reading.ru: «Ну так поезжайте сейчас», — сказала ему Львова, которой он передал это.
reading.question: What did Lvova advise Levin to do about his forgotten visit to Count Bol?
reading.explain: When Levin told Lvova he had forgotten his visit to Count Bol, she told him to go right away.
